company.description: Sana3ly is a mobile application that provides comprehensive solutions for purchasing spare parts and machinery for factories, streamlining the procurement process. Sana3ly provides a competitive, transparent, and fair environment to Manage the purchase requisitions and maintain all the industrial spare parts purchasing processes online in one place to provide the factory cost-saving, time-saving, transparency, and traceability Sana3ly uses a website and mobile app that works with Android and IOS versions in which the factory automatically creates spare part purchase requisitions with various categories, receives multiple quotations from suppliers, compares quotations, transmits POs to suppliers. Factory gathers all industrial purchasing items in one place. Control, track, and report the company’s spend.
